serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) is a FedRAMP Moderate Software as a Service (SaaS) enabling the ability to create, manage, and deliver digital experiences across every channel, including web, mobile apps, digital forms and communities, and on-site screens. Forrester ranks Adobe as the leader in agile content management, receiving the highest scores possible for current offerings, strategy, and market presence. This SaaS package includes Adobe Experience Manager Sites, Adobe Experience Manager Assets, and Adobe Experience Manager Forms for web content management, digital asset management, digital enrollment and smart forms, app development and management, and social communities capabilities. Agencies can build, share, and deliver personalized experiences across different channels from the same place and integrate digital enrollment and forms into websites and mobile experiences to streamline transactions. Adobe manages the most complex and mission-critical Adobe Experience Manager deployments all over the world and provides managed service cloud hosting and expert application support, enabling enterprises to concentrate on citizen engagement and digital transformation. Learn more here. https://business.adobe.com/products/experience-manager/adobe-experience-manager.html
